meaning.en: Restless, unwilling to settle, or inclined to go beyond conventional expectations. It can be mildly critical, but in context it may also suggest boldness or unusual ambition.
meaning.vi: Không yên phận, không chịu an phận thủ thường, hoặc có xu hướng vượt ra ngoài những kỳ vọng thông thường. Từ này có thể mang ý chê nhẹ, nhưng trong ngữ cảnh cũng có thể gợi sự táo bạo hay tham vọng khác thường.

vocabulary.example: 很多同學寫的是當老師、當司機、當公司職員，而大谷寫下的是一個看起來有些不安分的夢想。

meaning.en: Mental toughness and emotional steadiness, especially under the pressure of sports, exams, or competition. It is common in sports, education, and performance-related contexts.
meaning.vi: Bản lĩnh tâm lý và sự vững vàng về cảm xúc, đặc biệt là dưới áp lực của thể thao, thi cử hay thi đấu. Từ này thường gặp trong các ngữ cảnh thể thao, giáo dục và biểu diễn.

vocabulary.example: 必須練好力量、速度、自律、心理素質。

meaning.en: To act in a practical, grounded way and make steady, concrete progress rather than merely talking or dreaming. This is a strongly approving expression.
meaning.vi: Làm việc một cách thiết thực, vững chắc, tiến bộ đều đặn và cụ thể, thay vì chỉ nói suông hay mơ mộng. Đây là cách nói mang ý khen ngợi mạnh mẽ.

vocabulary.example: 他不是嘴上說我要成為明星球員而是腳踏實地一點一點朝那裡走。

transcript.text: 那時親戚朋友常勸他不要開車，可他自己樂在其中。

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他在香港開車的確有過危險。
transcript.translation: He has indeed had some dangerous moments while driving in Hong Kong.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 香港車輛是靠左行駛。
transcript.translation: In Hong Kong, vehicles drive on the left.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

transcript.translation: On two occasions, he drove onto the wrong side of the road while making a left turn, and the oncoming bus driver got so frustrated that he pointed at us and yelled.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 幸好那時大巴那邊是紅燈，所有的車輛停止不動，不然後果不堪設想。
transcript.translation: Fortunately, the traffic light for the bus was red at that moment, and all the vehicles had come to a complete stop; otherwise, the consequences would have been unimaginable.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那時我們開著一輛十多年的老車。
transcript.translation: Back then, we were driving an old car that was over ten years old.

transcript.translation: The first time Mr. Yang took me through the mountains and forests to Sha Tau Kok, after driving uphill for a while, the car’s air conditioning stopped working.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 香港的夏天非常悶熱，開著車窗還是很難受。
transcript.translation: Summers in Hong Kong are extremely muggy, and it’s still uncomfortable even with the car windows down.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 但是後來每每回想起來卻覺得十分有趣。
transcript.translation: But looking back on it now, I find it quite amusing.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 後來我們的確換了一輛新車，在前一輛車第十七個年頭時。
transcript.translation: Later, we did indeed trade in our car for a new one—in the seventeenth year of the previous one’s life.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 遇到下山的車時，只能其中一方退到稍微寬敞的地方讓行。
transcript.translation: When encountering a car coming downhill, one of the drivers must pull over to a slightly wider spot to let the other pass.

transcript.translation: This stretch of road might feel like walking on thin ice for a novice driver, but having already come halfway, there’s no turning back—you just have to grit your teeth and keep driving up the mountain.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 後來我問楊先生當時擔不擔心，他說一點都不擔心。

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

transcript.translation: Driving up Tai Mo Shan isn’t difficult, but when I pulled into a parking spot on the mountain, I mistook the gas pedal for the brake, and the car suddenly surged forward.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 車位前面兩三米就是山崖附近站著的幾個人都驚叫起來。
transcript.translation: Just two or three meters in front of the parking spot was a cliff, and the few people standing nearby all let out a startled cry.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 幸好我反應快，立即換踩剎車。
transcript.translation: Fortunately, I reacted quickly and immediately slammed on the brakes.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 逃過一場災難。
transcript.translation: Escaped a disaster.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

transcript.speaker: speaker_1

transcript.speaker: speaker_1

transcript.translation: Mr. Yang teased me, saying, “Back when you and your classmates went backpacking through the vast forests of Inner Mongolia, I thought you were quite the adventurer. I never expected you to be as timid as a mouse.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 不管他怎麼軟硬兼施我再也沒有上大帽山。
transcript.translation: No matter how much he tried to coax or pressure me, I never went back to Tai Mo Shan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

transcript.translation: Indeed, Hong Kong’s natural environment is truly unique, and even the scenery along the way never gets old.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

meaning.en: Here, to travel through mountainous and rural areas. In historical contexts, 上山下鄉 specifically refers to the Mao-era campaign that sent urban youths to live and work in the countryside.
meaning.vi: Ở đây có nghĩa là đi qua các vùng núi non và nông thôn. Trong ngữ cảnh lịch sử, 上山下鄉 chỉ riêng phong trào thời Mao đưa thanh niên thành thị về sống và lao động ở nông thôn.

vocabulary.example: 我剛拿到駕照，楊先生就要我開車上山下鄉。

meaning.en: To proceed with extreme caution because one is in a precarious or risky situation—literally, “as if walking on thin ice.” The expression is relatively formal and literary.
meaning.vi: Hành xử hết sức thận trọng vì đang ở trong tình thế bấp bênh hay nguy hiểm — nghĩa đen là “như đi trên băng mỏng”. Cách nói này tương đối trang trọng và mang tính văn chương.

vocabulary.example: 這段路程對新手來說會感覺如履薄冰，可是已經走到一半無法回頭，只能硬著頭皮往山上走。

meaning.en: To force oneself to do something difficult, frightening, or embarrassing despite feeling reluctant or afraid. It is common in conversational Chinese.
meaning.vi: Gượng ép bản thân làm một việc khó khăn, đáng sợ hay ngượng ngùng dù trong lòng miễn cưỡng hoặc lo sợ. Cụm từ này rất thông dụng trong tiếng Trung hội thoại.

vocabulary.example: 這段路程對新手來說會感覺如履薄冰，可是已經走到一半無法回頭，只能硬著頭皮往山上走。

meaning.en: To continue feeling frightened when remembering a danger or shock that has already passed. It is often used in written narratives and more polished speech.
meaning.vi: Vẫn còn thấy sợ khi nhớ lại một mối nguy hay cú sốc đã qua. Thường dùng trong văn kể chuyện và trong lời nói trau chuốt.

vocabulary.example: 只是過後每每想起都心有餘悸。楊先生卻不當一回事。

meaning.en: To use both gentle persuasion and forceful pressure to make someone comply. It often implies switching between coaxing and coercive tactics.
meaning.vi: Vừa dùng lời lẽ mềm mỏng thuyết phục vừa gây sức ép cứng rắn để buộc người khác nghe theo. Thường hàm ý luân phiên giữa dỗ dành và cưỡng ép.

vocabulary.example: 不管他怎麼軟硬兼施我再也沒有上大帽山。

meaning.en: To possess exceptional natural or circumstantial advantages that others do not have. It is an approving expression often used for places, environments, resources, or talent.
meaning.vi: Sở hữu những lợi thế đặc biệt về tự nhiên hay hoàn cảnh mà người khác không có. Đây là cách nói mang ý khen, thường dùng cho địa phương, môi trường, tài nguyên hay tài năng.

vocabulary.example: 的確香港的自然環境得天獨厚就連沿途的自然風光也百看不厭。

meaning.en: Exactly right in degree, timing, or execution—neither excessive nor insufficient. It is used approvingly in both speech and writing.
meaning.vi: Vừa vặn đúng mức, đúng lúc hoặc đúng cách — không thái quá cũng không thiếu. Dùng với ý khen trong cả văn nói lẫn văn viết.

vocabulary.example: 郊外的路徑和設施通常非常便利又絲毫沒有破壞大自然的美感一切人工干預恰到好處不多不少。

transcript.translation: Hello everyone! Today we’re bringing you a story titled “The Man Who Wouldn’t Bow to Fate.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 不像命運低頭的人。
transcript.translation: People who don’t bow to fate.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這一期的節目由我們的 Patrons 贊助和完成。
transcript.translation: This episode was sponsored and made possible by our Patrons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這裡感謝我們的 Patrons，沒有你們的支援和幫助，就沒有這一期的故事。
transcript.translation: We’d like to take this opportunity to thank our Patrons—without your support and help, this episode wouldn’t have been possible.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 沒錯，非常感謝我們的 Patrons。
transcript.translation: That’s right—a huge thank you to our Patrons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 啊，那我們希望有更多的人加入我們，成為我們的 Patrons。
transcript.translation: Oh, and we hope more people will join us and become our Patrons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 呃，這樣你不僅可以看到我們的每一期故事、故事解讀的文本，我們每一篇故事的詞彙，而且還有機會參加我們每個月的線上聊天，
transcript.translation: Well, that way, you’ll not only be able to access each episode’s story, the text of the story analysis, and the vocabulary for each story, but you’ll also have the chance to participate in our monthly online chats,

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 呃，和來自全世界不同地方的中學習者一起去聽中文和說中文。
transcript.translation: Um, join Chinese learners from all over the world to listen to and speak Chinese together.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 嗯，還等什麼呢？
transcript.translation: So, what are you waiting for?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 趕快加入吧。
transcript.translation: Join us now!

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 那我們來聽故事。
transcript.translation: Now, let’s listen to a story.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不像命運低頭的人。
transcript.translation: People who don’t bow to fate.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 不像命運低頭的人。
transcript.translation: People who don’t bow to fate.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 確診漸凍症那一天，蔡磊坐在醫生辦公室裡，窗外陽光很亮，醫生的聲音卻彷彿隔著一堵厚厚的牆傳過來。
transcript.translation: On the day he was diagnosed with ALS, Cai Lei sat in the doctor’s office. The sunlight streaming through the window was bright, yet the doctor’s voice seemed to come through as if from behind a thick wall.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 目前沒有治療方法，病情會逐漸發展。
transcript.translation: There is currently no cure, and the condition will gradually progress.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這句話像一塊沉重的石頭壓在他的生命上。
transcript.translation: Those words weighed on his life like a heavy stone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 那天回家，他第一次意識到，也許有一天，他連回家開門，端起一杯水，
transcript.translation: On his way home that day, he realized for the first time that perhaps one day, he wouldn’t even be able to open the door to his home or pour himself a glass of water,

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 甚至呼吸都會變得艱難。
transcript.translation: Even breathing becomes difficult.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 剛開始，他也有過無聲的崩潰。
transcript.translation: In the beginning, he, too, had his moments of silent despair.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 夜深人靜時，她一個人坐在黑暗裡，手指已經開始不聽使喚。
transcript.translation: Late at night, when all was quiet, she sat alone in the darkness, her fingers already beginning to tremble uncontrollably.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他試著握拳，卻怎麼都握不緊。
transcript.translation: He tried to clench his fist, but no matter how hard he tried, he just couldn’t get it closed.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 那種逐漸失去身體控制的恐懼是外人無法想象的。
transcript.translation: The fear of gradually losing control of one’s body is something outsiders cannot imagine.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 可第二天太陽昇起，他依舊穿好衣服出門工作，像什麼都沒發生一樣。
transcript.translation: But the next day, when the sun rose, he still got dressed and went to work, as if nothing had happened.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 但他不是一個只把痛苦藏起來的人，他選擇正面迎戰。
transcript.translation: But he wasn’t the kind of person who simply hid his pain—he chose to face it head-on.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他開始閱讀大量醫學資料，請醫生講解病理，聯絡科研團隊，像做一場巨大的專案管理一樣，去參與推動漸凍症研究。
transcript.translation: He began reading vast amounts of medical literature, asking doctors to explain the pathology, and reaching out to research teams—approaching the task like a massive project management endeavor—to actively contribute to and advance ALS research.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他成立公益基金，搭建溝通平臺，拉科研醫院、企業、公益機構一起合作。
transcript.translation: He established a public welfare foundation, built a communication platform, and brought together research hospitals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations to collaborate.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 別人勸他休息，他卻說："時間不是用來退縮的，而是用來搶救的。"
transcript.translation: When others urged him to rest, he replied, “Time isn’t for retreating—it’s for making a difference.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 隨著病情發展，他的動作越來越慢，說話越來越費力。
transcript.translation: As his condition progressed, his movements grew slower and slower, and speaking became increasingly difficult.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 有一次去醫院做檢查，他需要簽名確認，可手指幾乎握不住筆。
transcript.translation: Once, when he went to the hospital for a checkup, he needed to sign to confirm something, but his fingers could barely hold the pen.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 簽完那幾個字，他喘了一口氣，又笑著對醫生說：你看我還能簽字，我們還可以繼續努力。
transcript.translation: After signing those few characters, he took a deep breath and said to the doctor with a smile, “Look, I can still sign my name—we can keep fighting.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他常常去實驗室看科研團隊工作，穿著稍微笨重的外骨骼輔助裝置。
transcript.translation: He often visited the lab to watch the research team at work, wearing a slightly bulky exoskeleton assistive device.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他在儀器邊站著，一邊認真聽研究人員講解，一邊不斷提問，像一個著急趕時間的學生。
transcript.translation: He stood by the instrument, listening intently to the researcher’s explanation while asking questions one after another, like a student in a hurry.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 團隊成員說，她的眼睛裡的光始終很亮，那是一種我知道困難，但我不，我絕不退縮的光。
transcript.translation: A team member said that the light in her eyes was always bright—it was the kind of light that says, “I know there are difficulties, but I won’t—I absolutely will not—back down.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在對外發聲時，她沒有把自己放成可憐的病人，而是一個清醒、篤定、有責任的人
transcript.translation: When speaking publicly, she didn’t portray herself as a pitiful patient, but rather as a clear-headed, determined, and responsible person.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他在公開演講時說話已經有些吃力但每一個句子都極其堅定：“如果我倒下那就讓我倒在衝鋒的路上。”
transcript.translation: He was already struggling a bit to speak during his public speech, but every sentence was delivered with unwavering resolve: “If I fall, let me fall while charging forward.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在家裡他也不是隻談病的人他依然會和妻子聊工作 聊生活聊將來可做的計劃。
transcript.translation: At home, he didn’t just talk about his illness; he still chatted with his wife about work, daily life, and their future plans.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 妻子替他扣扣子扶他坐穩喂他吃飯時她常半開玩笑半認真地說：”
transcript.translation: When his wife buttoned his shirt, helped him sit up straight, and fed him, she would often say, half-jokingly, half-seriously: “

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 你是我的力量我得努力配得上你。“
transcript.translation: You are my strength; I must work hard to live up to you.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 身體被一點點鎖住可是他的世界卻沒有變小反而變得更加寬廣。
transcript.translation: Although his body was gradually becoming restricted, his world didn’t shrink—on the contrary, it grew even broader.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他推動政策關注漸凍症群體幫助更多病友獲得資訊與幫助讓那些本可能悄然消失在角落裡的患者看見彼此也被世界
transcript.translation: He has advocated for policies that support the ALS community, helping more patients access information and assistance—ensuring that those who might otherwise have faded into obscurity can see one another and be seen by the world.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 看見。
transcript.translation: See you.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 也許他無法阻止疾病的發展但他儘可能推著這場戰鬥往前走一點再走一點。
transcript.translation: Perhaps he couldn’t stop the disease from progressing, but he did his best to push the battle forward—a little at a time, step by step.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他為的是自己也是所有和他一樣的人漸凍症讓他的身體變得緩慢卻沒有凍結他的思考和意志。
transcript.translation: He did it for himself and for everyone like him. ALS may have slowed his body, but it hasn’t frozen his mind or his will.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他用行動給了大家一種答案命運可以殘酷但人可以選擇用怎樣的姿態去面對。
transcript.translation: Through his actions, he showed everyone that while fate can be cruel, people can choose how they face it.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 故事講完了聽故事說中文聽得越多 說得越好這裡是故事解讀解讀故事不像命運低頭的人。
transcript.translation: That’s the end of the story. The more you listen to “Listen to Stories, Speak Chinese,” the better you’ll speak. This is “Story Interpretation”: “Those Who Never Bow to Fate.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不像命運低頭的人。
transcript.translation: People who don’t bow to fate.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 如果你喜歡我們的故事。
transcript.translation: If you enjoy our stories.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 歡迎您在iTunes上給我們寫好評在Spotify上給我們點讚我們得到的好評和關注越多世界上就會有越來越多的人知道《聽故事Say中文》這個節目！
transcript.translation: Please feel free to leave us a review on iTunes and give us a thumbs-up on Spotify—the more positive feedback and attention we receive, the more people around the world will discover the *Listen to Stories, Say Chinese* podcast!

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 也歡迎您把我們的節目推薦給您的老師、同學和朋友我們得到的關注越多世界上就會有越來越多的人知道《聽故事Say中文》這個節目。
transcript.translation: Please feel free to recommend our show to your teachers, classmates, and friends—the more attention we get, the more people around the world will discover “Listen to Stories, Say Chinese”!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 沒錯那我們下次再聽。
transcript.translation: That’s right, so we’ll listen again next time.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 下次再見。
transcript.translation: See you next time.

meaning.en: The common Chinese name for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a progressive neurological disease that weakens the muscles used for voluntary movement. This is an everyday medical term rather than the formal name 肌萎縮側索硬化症.
meaning.vi: Tên gọi thông dụng trong tiếng Trung của bệnh xơ cứng teo cơ một bên (ALS), một bệnh thần kinh tiến triển làm suy yếu các cơ vận động chủ ý. Đây là từ y học đời thường, khác với tên gọi chính thức 肌萎縮側索硬化症.

vocabulary.example: 確診漸凍症那一天，蔡磊坐在醫生辦公室裡，窗外陽光很亮，醫生的聲音卻彷彿隔著一堵厚厚的牆傳過來。

meaning.en: To stop responding to someone’s control or intentions. It is a colloquial expression often used of a body part or machine, and sometimes of an uncooperative person.
meaning.vi: Không còn tuân theo sự điều khiển hay ý muốn của ai đó. Đây là cách nói khẩu ngữ, thường dùng cho một bộ phận cơ thể hoặc máy móc, đôi khi cho một người không chịu hợp tác.

vocabulary.example: 夜深人靜時，她一個人坐在黑暗裡，手指已經開始不聽使喚。

meaning.en: The pathology of a disease: the processes, mechanisms, and bodily changes involved in its development. This is a formal medical term.
meaning.vi: Bệnh lý của một căn bệnh: các quá trình, cơ chế và biến đổi trong cơ thể diễn ra khi bệnh phát triển. Đây là thuật ngữ y học trang trọng.

vocabulary.example: 他開始閱讀大量醫學資料，請醫生講解病理，聯絡科研團隊，像做一場巨大的專案管理一樣，去參與推動漸凍症研究。

meaning.en: An exoskeleton; in medical and engineering contexts, often a wearable mechanical structure that supports the body or assists movement. This is a technical term.
meaning.vi: Bộ xương ngoài; trong ngữ cảnh y học và kỹ thuật, thường chỉ một kết cấu cơ khí đeo trên người để nâng đỡ cơ thể hoặc hỗ trợ vận động. Đây là thuật ngữ chuyên môn.

vocabulary.example: 他常常去實驗室看科研團隊工作，穿著稍微笨重的外骨骼輔助裝置。

meaning.en: Firmly certain, composed, and unwavering in one’s beliefs or attitude. It has a polished, somewhat literary tone and often conveys quiet confidence.
meaning.vi: Chắc chắn, điềm tĩnh và không lay chuyển trong niềm tin hay thái độ. Từ này có sắc thái trau chuốt, hơi thiên về văn chương, và thường truyền tải sự tự tin trầm lặng.

vocabulary.example: 在對外發聲時，她沒有把自己放成可憐的病人，而是一個清醒、篤定、有責任的人

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文第九十三集張騫和絲綢之路。
transcript.translation: Tea Break in Chinese, Episode 93: Zhang Qian and the Silk Road.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大家好，你正在收聽的是茶歇中文播客。
transcript.translation: Hello everyone, you’re listening to the “Tea Break Chinese” podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我是 Nathan。
transcript.translation: I’m Nathan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在播客裡我們用簡單的中文聊有意思的話題。
transcript.translation: On our podcast, we chat about interesting topics in simple Chinese.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 前一段時間網上有一個影片很火，很火就是很流行的意思。
transcript.translation: A while back, a video went viral online—“viral” here means it was very popular.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在影片裡 SpaceX 的火箭慢慢地回到了地上。SpaceX 的老闆 Elon Musk 一直說有一天我們會把人送上火星，
transcript.translation: In the video, the SpaceX rocket slowly returns to the ground. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has always said that one day we’ll send people to Mars,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 送上 Mars。
transcript.translation: Sent to Mars.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今天我們的交通工具真的很厲害。
transcript.translation: Today, our means of transportation are truly amazing.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 飛機、火車、輪船、汽車，這些交通工具可以帶我們去世界上的每一個地方。
transcript.translation: Airplanes, trains, ships, and cars—these modes of transportation can take us to every corner of the world.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 以後我們可能會有火箭帶我們去別的星球。
transcript.translation: In the future, we might have rockets to take us to other planets.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: To infinity and beyond！
transcript.translation: To infinity and beyond!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是很久以前，這些交通工具還沒有被髮明的時候，旅行真的不簡單。
transcript.translation: But a long time ago, before these modes of transportation had been invented, traveling was really no easy task.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很多人一輩子都住在一個地方。
transcript.translation: Many people live in the same place their entire lives.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 以前的人有什麼交通工具呢？
transcript.translation: What kinds of transportation did people use back then?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們有馬車，有船，但是很慢。
transcript.translation: They had horse-drawn carts and boats, but they were very slow.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 從一個城市到另一個城市要很長的時間。
transcript.translation: It took a very long time to travel from one city to another.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 從一個國家到另一個國家呢？
transcript.translation: How did they travel from one country to another?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這幾乎是不可能的事情。
transcript.translation: That was practically impossible.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是就是有一些人，他們想要去別的地方看看，他們想知道在很遠很遠的地方有什麼樣的人，
transcript.translation: But there were some people who wanted to go see other places; they wanted to know what kind of people lived far, far away,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那些人是怎麼生活的，他們住在什麼樣的房子裡，他們吃什麼東西。
transcript.translation: How did those people live? What kind of houses did they live in? What did they eat?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這些人願意花很長很長的時間去很遠很遠的地方。
transcript.translation: These people were willing to spend a very, very long time traveling to places very, very far away.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們是誰？
transcript.translation: Who were they?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們是 Marco Polo，他們是 Christopher Columbus，他們是張騫。
transcript.translation: They were Marco Polo, they were Christopher Columbus, they were Zhang Qian.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫是誰？
transcript.translation: Who was Zhang Qian?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他是我們這一集節目的主角。
transcript.translation: He is the main character of this episode.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他生活在兩千多年前的中國，那時的朝代叫做漢朝。
transcript.translation: He lived in China more than 2,000 years ago, during a dynasty known as the Han Dynasty.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那時漢朝的政府問有誰願意出中國朝西走，看看西方的世界是怎樣的。
transcript.translation: At that time, the Han dynasty government asked if anyone was willing to travel westward from China to see what the world to the west was like.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫說我去。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian said, “I’ll go.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 於是一條很長的旅行就開始了。
transcript.translation: And so, a very long journey began.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這條很長的旅行，我們今天叫它絲綢之路。The Silk Road。
transcript.translation: This very long route is what we call today the Silk Road. The Silk Road.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫為什麼要去西方？
transcript.translation: Why did Zhang Qian go west?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他在西方看見了什麼？
transcript.translation: What did he see in the West?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 經歷了什麼？
transcript.translation: What happened?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這是我們今天要回答的問題。
transcript.translation: This is the question we’ll be answering today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 你準備好了嗎？
transcript.translation: Are you ready?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [音效]
transcript.translation: [Sound effect]

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們回到兩千多年前，看看那個時候的中國。
transcript.translation: Let’s go back more than 2,000 years and take a look at China at that time.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們會發現那個時候的中國比今天小很多。
transcript.translation: We’ll see that China at that time was much smaller than it is today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今天中國的東北、內蒙古、新疆、西藏這些地方以前都不在中國的地圖裡。
transcript.translation: Today’s Northeast China, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, and Tibet—these places were not on the map of China back then.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那時中國最北的地方差不多就是北京了。
transcript.translation: At that time, Beijing was practically the northernmost point of China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今天去北京，我們看什麼？
transcript.translation: What do we see when we visit Beijing today?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們看長城 The Great Wall。
transcript.translation: Let’s take a look at the Great Wall.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 聽節目的朋友，你們還記得我們的老朋友秦始皇嗎？
transcript.translation: Listeners, do you remember our old friend, Emperor Qin Shi Huang?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 就是他在北京開始建造長城。
transcript.translation: It was he who began building the Great Wall in Beijing.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 為什麼要建造長城呢？
transcript.translation: Why was the Great Wall built?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 因為北京的北方就不是中國了。
transcript.translation: Because north of Beijing was no longer part of China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在北方生活著一群人，他們不是中國人，不是漢人，而是匈奴人。
transcript.translation: A group of people lived in the north; they were not Chinese, nor were they Han Chinese—they were the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這些匈奴人沒有城市，沒有國家。
transcript.translation: These Xiongnu had no cities and no country.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們每天騎馬。
transcript.translation: They rode horses every day.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們喜歡打仗。
transcript.translation: They loved to fight.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 以前的中國人真的不喜歡這些匈奴人。
transcript.translation: The Chinese of that time really didn’t like these Xiongnu people.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: The emperor will stop you.
transcript.translation: The emperor will stop you.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: Stop me?
transcript.translation: Stop me?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: He invited me.
transcript.translation: He invited me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 秦朝的時候，匈奴人就一直跟漢人打仗。
transcript.translation: During the Qin Dynasty, the Xiongnu were constantly at war with the Han Chinese.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 秦朝結束來到漢朝，匈奴人還是繼續跟漢人打仗。
transcript.translation: After the Qin Dynasty ended and the Han Dynasty began, the Xiongnu continued to wage war against the Han people.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的政府真是頭疼。
transcript.translation: The Han Dynasty government really had its hands full.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們怎麼才能讓匈奴人走開呢？
transcript.translation: How can we get the Xiongnu to leave?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的政府聽說在很遠很遠的地方有一些人，這些人跟我們漢人一樣不喜歡匈奴。
transcript.translation: The Han Dynasty government heard that far, far away there were people who, just like us Han Chinese, disliked the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的政府於是說我們一定要跟這些人交朋友，這樣我們就可以一起打匈奴。
transcript.translation: The Han Dynasty government then decided that we must befriend these people so that we could fight the Xiongnu together.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這些不喜歡匈奴的人名字叫大月氏。
transcript.translation: The people who disliked the Xiongnu were called the Great Yuezhi.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的政府問大家有誰願意去找找這些大月氏人嗎？
transcript.translation: The Han Dynasty government asked if anyone was willing to go find these Great Yuezhi people.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很多人不願意。
transcript.translation: Many people were reluctant.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們在中國很好，為什麼要去別的地方？
transcript.translation: We’re doing just fine in China—why go anywhere else?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 只有一個人說我願意去。
transcript.translation: Only one person said, “I’m willing to go.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這個人就是張騫。
transcript.translation: That man was Zhang Qian.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那時候他三十六歲，在政府裡工作。
transcript.translation: At that time, he was thirty-six years old and working in the government.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的皇帝聽了很開心，給他準備了一百多個人，還給他準備了一個匈奴的導遊，
transcript.translation: The Han Dynasty emperor was delighted to hear this and provided him with over a hundred men, as well as a Xiongnu guide,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 名字叫甘父。
transcript.translation: His name was Gan Fu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 甘父雖然是匈奴人，但是一直生活在中國，是漢朝的好朋友。
transcript.translation: Although Gan Fu was a member of the Xiongnu, he had always lived in China and was a close friend of the Han Dynasty.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他願意幫助張騫一起找到大月氏。
transcript.translation: He was willing to help Zhang Qian find the Great Yuezhi.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 西元前一百三十九年， 一百多個人從中國出發。
transcript.translation: In 139 B.C., more than a hundred people set out from China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [音樂聲]路非常難走，有很多山。
transcript.translation: [Music] The road was very difficult to travel, with many mountains.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 一百個人只知道一件事情，朝西走。
transcript.translation: The hundred men knew only one thing: to head west.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 誰知道這時候匈奴聽說了有一些漢族人正在山裡。
transcript.translation: Little did they know that by this time, the Xiongnu had heard rumors that some Han Chinese were in the mountains.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫出發沒有很久就被匈奴捉住了。
transcript.translation: Not long after setting out, Zhang Qian was captured by the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: Nice work, gentlemen。
transcript.translation: Nice work, gentlemen.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 匈奴的王來看他們。
transcript.translation: The king of the Xiongnu came to visit them.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫本來以為匈奴會殺死他們，但是匈奴沒有這樣的意思。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian had originally thought the Xiongnu would kill them, but the Xiongnu had no such intention.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 匈奴的王也知道漢人很厲害，如果能跟漢人做朋友也是很好的。
transcript.translation: The king of the Xiongnu also knew that the Han people were formidable, and that it would be a good thing to befriend them.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他請張騫留下，跟匈奴生活在一起。
transcript.translation: He asked Zhang Qian to stay and live among the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 匈奴人對張騫很好，給他吃的，給他喝的。
transcript.translation: The Xiongnu treated Zhang Qian very well, giving him food and drink.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們還讓張騫跟一個匈奴女人結婚。
transcript.translation: They also arranged for Zhang Qian to marry a Xiongnu woman.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 就這樣，張騫和匈奴生活了十年。
transcript.translation: And so, Zhang Qian lived among the Xiongnu for ten years.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 對，你沒有聽錯。
transcript.translation: That’s right—you heard correctly.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 十年的時間裡，張騫一直跟匈奴還有他的匈奴太太一起生活。
transcript.translation: For ten years, Zhang Qian lived among the Xiongnu alongside his Xiongnu wife.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不過在心裡，他知道漢朝讓他出來不是跟敵人交朋友的。
transcript.translation: But deep down, he knew that the Han Dynasty hadn’t sent him out to make friends with the enemy.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他的作業，他的任務是繼續朝西走，找到敵人的敵人。
transcript.translation: His mission was to continue westward to find the enemy of his enemy.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 匈奴以為張騫愛上了這個新的生活，他們給他更多的自由。
transcript.translation: The Xiongnu thought Zhang Qian had fallen in love with this new life, so they gave him more freedom.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 一天晚上，張騫帶著他的人馬偷偷地離開了匈奴的地方。
transcript.translation: One night, Zhang Qian and his men secretly left the Xiongnu territory.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們騎著馬一直朝西走。
transcript.translation: They rode their horses westward.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這樣過了很多天，匈奴終於找不到他們了。
transcript.translation: After many days had passed in this way, the Xiongnu finally lost track of them.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這時候他們在今天的新疆。
transcript.translation: At this point, they were in what is now Xinjiang.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 一路上很多人沒有吃的東西，餓死了或者累死了。
transcript.translation: Along the way, many people had nothing to eat and died of hunger or exhaustion.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 幸好張騫的導遊甘父擅長打獵。
transcript.translation: Fortunately, Gan Fu, Zhang Qian’s guide, was skilled at hunting.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 餓的時候，甘父就打獵，然後大家吃鳥。
transcript.translation: Whenever they were hungry, Gan Fu would go hunting, and then everyone would eat the birds.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 又過了很多時候，他們來到了今天的烏茲別克。
transcript.translation: After a long time had passed, they arrived in what is now Uzbekistan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: друзья 。
transcript.translation:
Friends.
Welcome to Uzbekistan!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: Добро пожаловать в Узбекистан！
transcript.translation:
Friends.
Welcome to Uzbekistan!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [快節奏當地民謠] 兩百年前，Alexander the Great 來到過這裡。
transcript.translation: [Upbeat local folk song] Two hundred years ago, Alexander the Great came here.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在這裡是一個國家，名字叫大宛。
transcript.translation: Today, this is a country called Dayuan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大宛國的人住在這裡，他們有著白人的長相。
transcript.translation: The people of the Kingdom of Dayuan lived here; they had Caucasian features.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫問大宛國的國王：請問你們知道大月氏人嗎？
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian asked the king of Dayuan: “Do you know the Great Yuezhi?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 國王說：當然知道，我可以幫助你們，不過請你們先吃飯。
transcript.translation: The king said, “Of course I know. I can help you, but please have something to eat first.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫在離開中國的時候帶了一些禮物，他的打算是如果在路上認識了新朋友，就給他們這些禮物。
transcript.translation: When Zhang Qian left China, he took some gifts with him, intending to give them to any new friends he might meet along the way.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他把禮物給大宛的國王。
transcript.translation: He presented the gifts to the king of Dayuan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 國王一看，原來是中國的絲綢，silk 和茶。
transcript.translation: The king took a look and realized they were Chinese silk and tea.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大宛人從來沒有見過這麼漂亮的東西，他們都很開心。
transcript.translation: The people of Dayuan had never seen such beautiful things before, and they were all delighted.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大宛人對漢人說：“來，我給你們看好東西。”
transcript.translation: The people of Dayuan said to the Han: “Come, I’ll show you something wonderful.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫一看，原來是大宛的馬。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian took one look and realized they were horses from Dayuan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [馬嘶聲] 這些馬是紅色的，很好看。
transcript.translation: [Sound of horses neighing] These horses are red and very beautiful.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大宛人說這些馬是最好的，它們永遠不會累，旅行打仗都可以用它們。
transcript.translation: The people of Dayuan said these horses were the best; they never got tired and could be used for both travel and battle.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大宛人說我們幫助你們找到大月氏吧。
transcript.translation: The people of Dayuan said, “Let us help you find the Great Yuezhi.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們又聯絡了一個國家，然後那個國家代張騫找到了大月氏。
transcript.translation: They then contacted another country, and that country, on Zhang Qian’s behalf, located the Great Yuezhi.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫看見大月氏之人真的高興，他說請你們跟漢人一起打匈奴吧，我們互相幫助，一定能打敗匈奴。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian was truly delighted to see the Great Yuezhi people. He said, “Please join the Han people in fighting the Xiongnu. If we help each other, we will surely defeat the Xiongnu.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 誰知道十幾年的時間裡，大月氏已經搬家了。
transcript.translation: Little did anyone know that over the course of a dozen or so years, the Great Yuezhi had already moved on.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們住在今天的阿富汗，Afghanistan。
transcript.translation: They lived in what is now Afghanistan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大月氏說現在我們很喜歡這個地方，我們不想回去打仗了。
transcript.translation: The Great Yuezhi said, “We’ve grown to love this place; we don’t want to go back to war.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在匈奴不是我們的敵人了，請你回家吧。
transcript.translation: The Xiongnu are no longer our enemies; please go home.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫聽了很失望，但是沒有別的辦法。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian was very disappointed to hear this, but there was nothing else he could do.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 敵人的敵人已經沒有了，現在只能回家了。
transcript.translation: With the enemy’s enemy gone, there was nothing left to do but return home.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 回家的路上，張騫說我們不要走有匈奴的路。
transcript.translation: On the way home, Zhang Qian said, “Let’s not take the route used by the Xiongnu.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 於是他們走了一條新的路。
transcript.translation: So they set out on a new path.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 沒想到這條路上還是有匈奴，他們又被捉住了。
transcript.translation: Unexpectedly, there were still Xiongnu along this route, and they were captured once again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [音效] 匈奴的王又來見他，說：嘿，老朋友，你還記得我嗎？
transcript.translation: [Sound effect] The Xiongnu king came to see him again and said, “Hey, old friend, do you still remember me?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 快來，我還是不會殺死你。
transcript.translation: Come on, I still won’t kill you.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 你跟我們一起生活吧。
transcript.translation: Come live with us.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 就這樣，張騫又跟匈奴住了一年。
transcript.translation: And so, Zhang Qian spent another year living among the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有一天，這個匈奴的王去世了，他的兒子們都說自己要當匈奴的王。
transcript.translation: One day, the Xiongnu king died, and his sons all claimed the throne for themselves.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 張騫用這個機會帶著自己的匈奴太太回到了中國。
transcript.translation: Zhang Qian took this opportunity to return to China with his Xiongnu wife.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 西元前126年，張騫回家了。
transcript.translation: In 126 BC, Zhang Qian returned home.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 從他離開中國一直到他回來，一共是十三年。
transcript.translation: From the time he left China until his return, a total of thirteen years had passed.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 走的時候有一百多個人。
transcript.translation: When he passed away, there were over a hundred people with him.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 聽節目的朋友，你猜猜回來的有幾個人？
transcript.translation: Listeners, can you guess how many people actually returned?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 答案是兩個人，一個是張騫，一個是他的匈奴導遊。
transcript.translation: The answer is two people: Zhang Qian and his Xiongnu guide.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝政府聽說大月氏不想打匈奴了，有點失望。
transcript.translation: The Han government was somewhat disappointed to hear that the Great Yuezhi no longer wished to fight the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是張騫告訴了大家，他一路上看見的不一樣的人，不一樣的城市，不一樣的文化。
transcript.translation: But Zhang Qian told everyone about the different people, cities, and cultures he had encountered along the way.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 漢朝的皇帝覺得太有意思了，他對大宛國的馬特別感興趣。
transcript.translation: The Han emperor found this fascinating; he was particularly interested in the horses of the Kingdom of Dayuan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 皇帝說：“張騫，你下次再去那裡給我一匹紅色的馬吧。”
transcript.translation: The emperor said, “Zhang Qian, next time you go there, bring me a red horse.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 皇帝說；“張騫，你下次再去那裡，給我帶回來一匹紅色的馬吧。
transcript.translation: The emperor said, “Zhang Qian, the next time you go there, bring me back a red horse.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [古風背景音樂]七年後，五十六歲的張騫帶著三百個人，
transcript.translation: [Ancient-style background music] Seven years later, the 56-year-old Zhang Qian set out with 300 men,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 還有很多很多的禮物再一次朝西走。
transcript.translation: And once again, a great many gifts made their way westward.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這次禮物有牛、羊、玉器、銅器，當然還有絲綢。
transcript.translation: The gifts on this occasion included cattle, sheep, jade artifacts, bronze artifacts, and, of course, silk.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 每次到一個地方，張騫就把禮物送給那裡的人，然後告訴他們：我們是漢人，我們的國家很強大，
transcript.translation: Every time he arrived at a new place, Zhang Qian would present gifts to the local people and tell them: “We are Han Chinese, and our country is very powerful,”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 歡迎你們跟我們做朋友。
transcript.translation: We welcome you to be our friends.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果你願意跟我們一起打匈奴的話，我們就是最好的朋友。
transcript.translation: If you’re willing to join us in fighting the Xiongnu, we’ll be the best of friends.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 結果呢？
transcript.translation: And what happened?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 還是沒有人想跟中國人一起打匈奴。
transcript.translation: Still, no one wanted to join the Chinese in fighting the Xiongnu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不過大家收到禮物都很開心。
transcript.translation: But everyone was very happy to receive the gifts.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 西元前一百十四年，六十一歲的張騫去世。
transcript.translation: In 114 BCE, Zhang Qian died at the age of 61.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 一八七零年左右，德國人Ferdinand von Richthofen研究中國的歷史，他把這條張騫走過的路叫做絲綢之路।
transcript.translation: Around 1870, the German Ferdinand von Richthofen studied Chinese history and named the route traveled by Zhang Qian the Silk Road.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [唱歌]多長啊，這一段四季 [唱]要用百年來-
transcript.translation: [Singing] How long is this cycle of the four seasons? [Singing] It takes a hundred years—

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這就是張騫的一生，還有絲綢之路的歷史。
transcript.translation: This is the story of Zhang Qian’s life and the history of the Silk Road.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 希望你覺得這段歷史有意思。
transcript.translation: We hope you find this bit of history interesting.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今天我們不知道張騫的父母是誰，他小時候的生活是怎樣的。
transcript.translation: Today, we don’t know who Zhang Qian’s parents were or what his life was like when he was a child.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們只知道他花了快二十年的時間去了西方很多的小國家。
transcript.translation: All we know is that he spent nearly twenty years traveling to many small countries in the West.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 中國人對那些國家有了更多的認識，那些國家的人也對中國有了不少了解。
transcript.translation: Chinese people have gained a better understanding of those countries, and people in those countries have also learned a great deal about China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 一個人的力氣很小，但是它也能做很厲害的事情。
transcript.translation: One person’s strength may be small, but it can still accomplish great things.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0

meaning.vi: Triều đại: một thời kỳ Trung Quốc do một hoàng tộc cụ thể cai trị. Chủ yếu dùng khi bàn về lịch sử và văn hóa.

vocabulary.example: 他生活在兩千多年前的中國，那時的朝代叫做漢朝。

meaning.en: A member of the Xiongnu, an ancient nomadic confederation that lived north of early imperial China. This is a specialized historical term.
meaning.vi: Người Hung Nô, thành viên của một liên minh du mục cổ đại sống ở phía bắc Trung Quốc thời kỳ đầu đế chế. Đây là thuật ngữ lịch sử chuyên biệt.

vocabulary.example: 在北方生活著一群人，他們不是中國人，不是漢人，而是匈奴人。

meaning.en: A body of people or forces belonging to a leader; historically, it can suggest both troops and horses. In modern informal use, it may also mean a team or contingent.
meaning.vi: Lực lượng hay nhân sự thuộc quyền một thủ lĩnh; trong lịch sử có thể hàm ý cả quân lính lẫn ngựa. Trong cách dùng hiện đại thân mật, cũng có thể chỉ một đội hay một nhóm.

vocabulary.example: 一天晚上，張騫帶著他的人馬偷偷地離開了匈奴的地方。

meaning.en: To insert a brief advertisement, announcement, or news item into a broadcast or program. This is a media and broadcasting term.
meaning.vi: Chèn một mẩu quảng cáo, thông báo hay bản tin ngắn vào giữa một chương trình phát sóng. Đây là thuật ngữ truyền thông và phát thanh truyền hình.

transcript.text: 茶歇中文第94集，一起讀瓊瑤的《陌生人》。
transcript.translation: Tea Break Chinese Episode 94: Let’s read Qiong Yao’s *The Stranger* together.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [片頭音樂]大家好，你正在收聽的是茶歇中文播客。
transcript.translation: [Opening Music] Hello everyone, you’re listening to the Tea Break Chinese Podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我是Nathan。
transcript.translation: My name is Nathan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在節目裡我們用簡單的中文聊有意思的話題。
transcript.translation: On the show, we chat about interesting topics in simple Chinese.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 馬上一年快結束了。
transcript.translation: The year is almost over.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在不少西方的國家，人們開始準備聖誕節Christmas。
transcript.translation: In many Western countries, people are starting to get ready for Christmas.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 商店裡、路上到處都是聖誕節日的感覺。
transcript.translation: The stores and the streets are filled with the Christmas spirit.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我坐在一家咖啡館裡寫這一集節目。
transcript.translation: Now I’m sitting in a café writing this episode.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 最近我結束了在一個法國公司的實習，開始找一個新的工作。
transcript.translation: I recently finished an internship at a French company and have started looking for a new job.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有時候我看見有意思的工作就把簡歷發給公司。
transcript.translation: Sometimes when I see an interesting job opening, I send my resume to the company.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 別的時候我看書學習。
transcript.translation: The rest of the time, I read and study.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 總是呆在家裡不好因為我老是想休息所以我常常出門去學校，咖啡館，圖書館等等。
transcript.translation: It’s not good to stay home all the time because I’m always wanting to rest, so I often go out—to school, cafes, the library, and so on.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在在法國，人們可以在家裡工作。
transcript.translation: Now in France, people can work from home.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我覺得在家裡人們很難認真工作。
transcript.translation: I feel like it’s hard for people to work seriously at home.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 你同意嗎？
transcript.translation: Do you agree?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 可能這是我自己的問題。
transcript.translation: Maybe this is just my own problem.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 對了，如果你還沒有聽說我們的新的節目的話，一定要去聽聽。
transcript.translation: By the way, if you haven’t heard about our new show yet, be sure to check it out.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們的新的節目的名字是茶歇新聞TeaTime News。
transcript.translation: The name of our new program is TeaTime News.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在新聞裡，我們用簡單的中文給大家介紹有意思的新聞。
transcript.translation: In this segment, we’ll use simple Chinese to introduce you to some interesting news stories.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我和文嘉會給大家講很多發生在中國的事情，這樣大家可以更好地瞭解中國文化。
transcript.translation: Wenjia and I will share many stories about what happens in China so that everyone can better understand Chinese culture.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在上個星期的茶歇新聞播客裡，我跟大家分享了瓊瑤去世的訊息。
transcript.translation: In last week’s “Tea Break News” podcast, I shared the news of Qiong Yao’s passing with everyone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 瓊瑤是中國的作家，她寫的很多小說被做成了電影，電視劇。
transcript.translation: Qiong Yao is a Chinese writer; many of her novels have been adapted into movies and TV series.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不少大陸，臺灣還有別的亞洲國家的人都是看她的電影和電視劇長大的。
transcript.translation: Many people in mainland China, Taiwan, and other Asian countries grew up watching her movies and TV shows.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果大家想了解她的一生的話，請你聽聽上個星期的茶歇新聞播客。
transcript.translation: If you’d like to learn more about her life, please listen to last week’s Tea Break News podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [音效]在今天的節目裡，我就想跟大家分享一篇瓊瑤寫的小說。
transcript.translation: [Sound effect] In today’s program, I’d like to share a short story by Qiong Yao with you all.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 老實說，我從來沒有讀過她的小說為什麼呢？
transcript.translation: To be honest, I’ve never read any of her novels. Why is that?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 第一，它在我父母的年代非常流行到了我的年代就沒有那麼流行了。
transcript.translation: First, it was very popular in my parents’ generation, but by my generation, it wasn’t as popular anymore.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 當然，我們都和家人看過一點點它的電視劇但是從來沒有讀過她寫的東西。
transcript.translation: Of course, we’ve all watched a little bit of her TV shows with our families, but we’ve never read anything she’s written.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 第二他寫的東西都是關於愛情的故事一個女生愛上了一個男生然後另一個男生又愛上了這個女生。
transcript.translation: Second, everything he wrote was about love stories—a girl falls in love with a boy, and then another boy falls in love with that girl.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 小時候我從來不讀這樣的東西。
transcript.translation: When I was a kid, I never read things like this.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這個星期我自己讀了四五篇瓊瑤寫的小說有長的有短的從中我選了一篇想跟大家分享這篇小說的名字是《陌
transcript.translation: This week, I read four or five short stories by Qiong Yao on my own—some long, some short. From among them, I’ve chosen one to share with you all. The title of this story is “A Stranger...”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 生人》。“陌生人” 這個詞是什麼意思？
transcript.translation: "Stranger." What does the word "stranger" mean?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 陌生人的意思就是一個不認識的人一個stranger。
transcript.translation: A “stranger” means someone you don’t know—a stranger.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這個故事裡有一個十八歲的女生有一天一個陌生人進入了她的生活這個陌生人是誰？
transcript.translation: In this story, an 18-year-old girl has a stranger enter her life one day. Who is this stranger?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 讀了故事你就會知道。
transcript.translation: You’ll find out when you read the story.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 因為這篇小說的主角是一個女生所以我請了文佳給大家讀因為這篇文章的語言很漂亮，
transcript.translation: Since the main character of this story is a girl, I asked Wenjia to read it to everyone because the language in this piece is so beautiful,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 可能不容易明白，所以我們用簡單的中文重新寫了這個故事，希望你喜歡。
transcript.translation: This might be a little hard to understand, so we’ve rewritten the story in simple Chinese. We hope you like it.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我們來聽瓊瑤的小說《陌生人》。"
transcript.translation: Now let’s listen to Qiong Yao’s novel *The Stranger*."

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [鋼琴音樂]陌生人。
transcript.translation: [Piano music] A stranger.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 一個星期六的晚上，我第一次看見那個陌生人，他在我的窗戶外面。
transcript.translation: One Saturday night, I saw that stranger for the first time—he was standing outside my window.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 那一天，我和爸爸媽媽在客廳裡聽了古典音樂，然後我回到臥室裡開啟燈，開始寫日記。
transcript.translation: That day, my parents and I listened to classical music in the living room, and then I went back to my bedroom, turned on the light, and started writing in my diary.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [筆刷紙的聲音] 寫什麼呢？
transcript.translation: [Sound of a brush on paper] What should I write?

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 寫今天發生的事情。
transcript.translation: Write about what happened today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 不過今天太無聊了，我想了很久，一個字也沒有寫。
transcript.translation: But today was so boring; I thought about it for a long time, but I didn’t write a single word.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我開啟窗戶想看月亮，可是我看到了他。
transcript.translation: I opened the window to look at the moon, but I saw him instead.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他站在一個路燈下面，看著我的房間。
transcript.translation: He was standing under a streetlight, looking at my room.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 路燈下，我能清楚地看見他。
transcript.translation: Under the streetlight, I could see him clearly.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他個子很高，穿著白色的衣服。
transcript.translation: He was very tall and wearing white clothes.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他安靜地看著我。
transcript.translation: He watched me quietly.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我有點害怕，把窗戶關上，然後坐下。
transcript.translation: I was a little scared, so I closed the window and sat down.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 但是我的心裡很不平靜。
transcript.translation: But I felt very uneasy inside.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 十分鐘後，我再看窗外，他已經走了。
transcript.translation: Ten minutes later, when I looked out the window again, he was gone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 三天後的晚上，那個陌生人再一次出現在我的窗外。
transcript.translation: Three days later, that night, the stranger appeared outside my window once again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我明白他真的在看我。
transcript.translation: I realized he was really looking at me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他等了五分鐘，然後又走了。
transcript.translation: He waited five minutes, then left again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 過了幾天，是一個下雨的晚上，我在寫東西，然後一抬頭，我看到了他。
transcript.translation: A few days later, on a rainy evening, I was writing something when I looked up and saw him.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我看著他，他也看著我。
transcript.translation: I looked at him, and he looked back at me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 雨越來越大，但是他還是沒有走。
transcript.translation: The rain was getting heavier, but he still didn’t leave.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我沒有把這個陌生人的事情告訴爸爸媽媽。
transcript.translation: I didn’t tell my parents about this stranger.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 每天晚上，我們一家人喜歡一起聽音樂。
transcript.translation: Every night, our family likes to listen to music together.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 有一天晚上，爸爸說:'佩蓉，你已經十九歲了，再過兩年，你應該找個男朋友結婚了。'
transcript.translation: One evening, Dad said, “Peirong, you’re already nineteen. In two years, you should find a boyfriend and get married.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '別說了，爸爸。'
transcript.translation: "Don’t say anything, Dad."

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我說。
transcript.translation: I said.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '永遠長不大。
transcript.translation: 'You’ll never grow up.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 去聽你的莫特吧。'
transcript.translation: "Go listen to your Mot."

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 爸爸說。
transcript.translation: Dad said.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '不是莫特，是莫札特。'
transcript.translation: 'Not Mott, Mozart.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我生氣地說。
transcript.translation: I said angrily.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '好好，莫札特。'
transcript.translation: 'All right, Mozart.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 爸爸笑著說。
transcript.translation: Dad said with a smile.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 媽媽也笑了。
transcript.translation: Mom laughed, too.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 爸爸學的是建築，他喜歡畫畫。
transcript.translation: Dad studied architecture, and he likes to draw.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 媽媽學的是鋼琴，而我學了小提琴。
transcript.translation: Mom studied piano, and I studied the violin.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 在這樣的家裡長大，我是幸福的。
transcript.translation: Growing up in a home like that, I was happy.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我從來沒有想過什麼男朋友的事情，我只要爸爸媽媽和我的音樂。
transcript.translation: I’d never even thought about having a boyfriend; all I wanted were my mom and dad and my music.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我沒有把陌生人的事情告訴爸爸媽媽。
transcript.translation: I didn’t tell my mom and dad about the stranger.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 但是那個下雨的晚上以後，過了一個星期，他又來了。
transcript.translation: But a week after that rainy night, he came back.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 那一天，我正在練習小提琴，突然我看見了他。
transcript.translation: That day, I was practicing the violin when suddenly I saw him.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我的房間在一樓，這一次他就在我的旁邊。
transcript.translation: My room is on the first floor, and this time he was right next to me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我拿著小提琴看著他，他的眼睛好像在對我說話，我想知道他在說什麼。
transcript.translation: I looked at him, holding my violin, and his eyes seemed to be speaking to me; I wondered what he was saying.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [開門聲] 這時門開了，媽媽進來了，她說為什麼不拉小提琴了？
transcript.translation: [Sound of a door opening] Just then, the door opened, and Mom came in. She asked, “Why aren’t you playing the violin anymore?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 再拉一遍吧。
transcript.translation: Let’s do it again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '好的，媽媽。'
transcript.translation: 'Okay, Mom.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我說。
transcript.translation: I said.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我再看窗外，那個陌生人已經不見了。
transcript.translation: I looked out the window again, but the stranger was already gone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我再一次拉琴。
transcript.translation: I started playing the violin again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他是誰？
transcript.translation: Who is he?

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 他為什麼要站在我的窗外？
transcript.translation: Why was he standing outside my window?

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我沒有心情拉琴，錯了好幾個地方。
transcript.translation: I wasn’t in the mood to play the violin, and I made several mistakes.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 媽媽吃驚地問我怎麼了。
transcript.translation: Mom asked me in surprise what was wrong.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '沒什麼。'
transcript.translation: 'Nothing.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我生氣地說。
transcript.translation: I said angrily.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '今天晚下拉不好琴，不拉了。'
transcript.translation: 'I can’t play the piano well tonight, so I’m not going to play.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 媽媽安靜地說： '有什麼事要告訴我嗎？
transcript.translation: Mom said quietly, “Is there something you want to tell me?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 是不是有男朋友了?'
transcript.translation: "Do you have a boyfriend?"

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: '哦，媽媽。'
transcript.translation: 'Oh, Mom.'

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 我說։ '你知道不會有的。'
transcript.translation: I said: “You know that’s not going to happen.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: 媽媽擔心地看著我，然後走了。
transcript.translation: Mom looked at me with concern, then walked away.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1

transcript.text: 我問。"

transcript.text: 我有點生氣。「

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文第九十五集，2024年總結。
transcript.translation: Tea Break Chinese Episode 95: 2024 Year-End Wrap-Up.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [背景音樂]大家好，歡迎回到茶歇中文播客。
transcript.translation: [Background music] Hello everyone, welcome back to the Tea Break Chinese podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 你正在收聽的是節目的第九十五集，這也是我們2024年的最後一集節目。
transcript.translation: You’re listening to the 95th episode of the show, which is also our final episode of 2024.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 馬上舊的一年要過去了，新的一年要來了。
transcript.translation: The old year is about to end, and the new year is just around the corner.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在很多西方國家，我想大家應該都在準備聖誕節。
transcript.translation: In many Western countries, I imagine everyone is getting ready for Christmas.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 聖誕節對很多人來說是一個一家人一起吃飯，一起聊天的時間。
transcript.translation: For many people, Christmas is a time to eat and chat together as a family.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果你過聖誕節的話，我祝你快樂。
transcript.translation: If you celebrate Christmas, I wish you a Merry Christmas.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在中國，雖然大部分人不過聖誕節，但是有時候人們也會做一些西方人做的事情。
transcript.translation: In China, although most people don’t celebrate Christmas, sometimes people do things that Westerners do.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 比如說在大城市裡，你會看見聖誕樹和其他聖誕節的裝飾。
transcript.translation: For example, in big cities, you’ll see Christmas trees and other Christmas decorations.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我記得我是學生的時候，我們會互相寫聖誕賀卡。
transcript.translation: I remember when I was a student, we used to write Christmas cards to each other.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 賀卡就是一張很漂亮的卡片，我們會在上面寫：祝你聖誕節快樂，祝你新年快樂等等。
transcript.translation: A greeting card is a beautiful card on which we write things like “Merry Christmas” or “Happy New Year,” and so on.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有時候學生之間還會交換聖誕禮物。
transcript.translation: Sometimes students even exchange Christmas gifts with one another.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這一集節目裡，我想簡單地跟大家分享一下2024年茶歇中文做了哪些事情？
transcript.translation: In this episode, I’d like to briefly share with you what Tea Break Chinese has been up to in 2024.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 2025年我們想做什麼事情。
transcript.translation: What do we want to accomplish in 2025?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我也會跟大家分享我自己生活裡發生的事情。
transcript.translation: I’ll also share stories from my own life with you all.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們開始吧！
transcript.translation: Let’s get started!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 2024年我們做了哪些事情呢？
transcript.translation: What did we accomplish in 2024?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 第一，我們繼續做茶歇中文播客。
transcript.translation: First, we’ll continue producing the “Tea Break Chinese” podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在2024年一年裡，我們做了十二集節目，差不多是一個月一集。
transcript.translation: In 2024 alone, we produced twelve episodes—roughly one per month.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這十二集節目裡，我們聊了很多有意思的話題。
transcript.translation: In these twelve episodes, we’ve discussed many interesting topics.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有的聽眾告訴我，他們喜歡茶歇中文播客，就是因為我們選擇的話題都很有意思。
transcript.translation: Some listeners have told me that they like the "Tea Break Chinese" podcast precisely because we choose such interesting topics.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這些話題有的是我自己感興趣的，有的是聽眾朋友們推薦給我的。
transcript.translation: Some of these topics are ones I’m personally interested in, while others were recommended to me by our listeners.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 每次我們都會花時間自己去學習，然後再用簡單的中文給大家講解。
transcript.translation: Every time, we take the time to learn the material ourselves, and then explain it to everyone in simple Chinese.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們希望聽節目的你能一邊學習中文，一邊學到新的知識，那麼我們就很開心了。
transcript.translation: We’d be delighted if you, our listeners, could learn Chinese and gain new knowledge at the same time.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在新的一年裡，茶歇中文播客當然還要繼續。
transcript.translation: In the new year, the Tea Break Chinese podcast will, of course, continue.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 第二，我們開始了茶歇新聞播客。
transcript.translation: Second, we launched the Tea Break News podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇新聞播客是我和文嘉一起做的，我主要講政治、經濟的話題，文嘉主要講社會文化的話題。
transcript.translation: The “Tea Break News” podcast is a collaboration between Wen Jia and me; I mainly cover political and economic topics, while Wen Jia focuses on social and cultural issues.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們希望給大家介紹發生在中國的事情。
transcript.translation: We want to share with everyone what’s happening in China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 為什麼說講中國的新聞很重要呢？
transcript.translation: Why is it important to report on news from China?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 因為我發現每個國家的媒體都喜歡講自己國家的事情。
transcript.translation: Because I’ve noticed that media outlets in every country tend to focus on their own country’s affairs.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 美國的媒體講美國的新聞，法國的媒體講法國的新聞。
transcript.translation: American media cover American news, and French media cover French news.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很多人不知道世界上別的地方都發生著什麼事情。
transcript.translation: Many people don’t know what’s happening in other parts of the world.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 西方的媒體有時會說中國的新聞，但是都是一些不好的事情或者奇怪的事情。
transcript.translation: Western media sometimes reports on news from China, but it’s usually just negative or strange stories.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 聽了新聞，大家很容易覺得嗯，中國真的是一個很不好的國家，我真的不想去中國。
transcript.translation: After listening to the news, it’s easy for people to think, “Hmm, China really is a terrible country; I really don’t want to go there.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我給大家一個例子吧。
transcript.translation: Let me give you an example.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我在法國的公司當實習生的時候，同事都是一些很友好的法國人，他們對我真的很好。
transcript.translation: When I was an intern at a company in France, my coworkers were all very friendly French people, and they were really kind to me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是我也發現大家對中國真的什麼都不知道。
transcript.translation: But I’ve also noticed that people really don’t know anything about China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有一次一個同事告訴我：Hey Nathan，上次我看新聞，新聞說中國造了一個很大的樓，
transcript.translation: Once, a colleague told me, “Hey Nathan, I was watching the news the other day, and it said China built a huge building,”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這個樓是專門用來養豬的。
transcript.translation: This building is specifically used for raising pigs.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [豬叫]中國人吃很多豬肉，所以要把豬放在很高的大樓裡來養。
transcript.translation: [Pig squeal] Chinese people eat a lot of pork, so they have to raise pigs in very tall buildings.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 中國真的是一個很奇怪的國家啊！
transcript.translation: China really is a very strange country!

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 後來我發現這個新聞是真的，真的有這樣的一個大樓。
transcript.translation: Later, I found out that this news story was true—there really is such a building.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我想很多中國人都不知道這件事情，為什麼法國的媒體要說呢？
transcript.translation: I think many Chinese people don’t know about this—so why would the French media report on it?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很多法國人不知道中國的歷史，沒有讀過中國的書，他們只知道在中國有一個很高的養豬的大樓。
transcript.translation: Many French people don’t know much about Chinese history and haven’t read any books about China; all they know is that there’s a very tall pig farm building in China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我覺得真的太可惜了。
transcript.translation: I think that’s such a shame.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我想做茶歇新聞已經很久了。
transcript.translation: I’ve wanted to do “Tea Break News” for a long time.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我真的希望聽了查些新聞，大家能瞭解到中國的美麗的地方。
transcript.translation: I really hope that by listening to “Tea Break News,” everyone will get to know the beautiful parts of China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 第三，茶歇中文是一個公司了。
transcript.translation: Third, Tea Break Chinese is now a company.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今年的九月，茶歇中文在香港註冊了公司。
transcript.translation: This past September, Tea Break Chinese registered as a company in Hong Kong.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 為什麼要成立公司呢？
transcript.translation: Why did we decide to establish a company?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 因為我想象十年、二十年後，Tea Time 會變成一個大公司，我們會做播客，我們會做採訪，
transcript.translation: Because I imagine that in ten or twenty years, Tea Time will become a big company—we’ll produce podcasts, we’ll conduct interviews,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們還會做電影等等。
transcript.translation: We’ll also be making movies and more.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 剛才我說很多外國人不瞭解中國是一件很可惜的事情。
transcript.translation: Earlier, I mentioned that it’s a real shame that many foreigners don’t understand China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 其實中國人自己也做得不好。
transcript.translation: Actually, even the Chinese themselves aren’t doing a very good job.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 中國人沒有努力把自己介紹給全世界。
transcript.translation: The Chinese haven’t made much of an effort to introduce themselves to the world.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 比如說我發現在 YouTube 上其實有不少很好的中文的電影、紀錄片、採訪，但是這些影片都是給中國人看的。
transcript.translation: For example, I’ve found that there are actually quite a few excellent Chinese-language movies, documentaries, and interviews on YouTube, but these videos are all intended for Chinese audiences.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我想如果加上英文的字幕，這樣全世界的人都可以看了，那就好了。
transcript.translation: I think it would be great if we added English subtitles so people all over the world could watch it.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我會努力讓 TeaTime 變成一箇中文的媒體公司，這樣中國人可以看，學習中文的人也可以看。
transcript.translation: I’ll do my best to turn TeaTime into a Chinese-language media company, so that both Chinese people and those learning Chinese can enjoy it.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們有很多想做的事情，我們會一點一點，一步一步地去做。
transcript.translation: We have a lot we want to do, and we’ll tackle it bit by bit, step by step.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [音效]我也花一點時間跟大家分享一下我自己的生活吧。
transcript.translation: [Sound effect] I’d also like to take a moment to share a bit about my own life with you all.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 最近我從法國的大學裡畢業了。
transcript.translation: I recently graduated from a university in France.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 畢業的意思就是我結束了學校裡的所有的課，現在已經不是學生了。
transcript.translation: Graduation means I’ve finished all my classes at school, and I’m no longer a student.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 當然，我希望能把所有的時間用來做茶歇中文。
transcript.translation: Of course, I hope to devote all my time to “Tea Break Chinese.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不過現在可能還不是時間，所以我會找一個工作，希望這會是一個有意思的工作。
transcript.translation: But now might not be the right time, so I’m going to look for a job—hopefully one that’s interesting.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 以後有一天我會把所有的時間都用在茶歇的工作上。
transcript.translation: Someday, I’ll devote all my time to working on “Tea Break.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在你在聽節目的時候，我其實已經回到中國了。
transcript.translation: As you’re listening to this episode, I’ve actually already returned to China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 對，我會回中國一段時間。
transcript.translation: Right, I’ll be going back to China for a while.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有時候法國人問我：你在法國多長時間了？
transcript.translation: Sometimes French people ask me, “How long have you been in France?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我說三年了。
transcript.translation: I’ve been saying this for three years now.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他們問我：三年裡你回過中國嗎？
transcript.translation: They asked me: “Have you been back to China in the past three years?”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我說沒有。
transcript.translation: I said no.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 大家都很吃驚。
transcript.translation: Everyone was surprised.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我也覺得是時候回去看看了。
transcript.translation: Now I think it’s time for me to go back and take a look, too.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 三年裡，我經常看中國的新聞。
transcript.translation: Over the past three years, I’ve often watched Chinese news.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我知道中國發生了很多變化這次我想回去看看這些變化是不是真的。
transcript.translation: I know a lot has changed in China, and this time I want to go back and see if those changes are real.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在以後的節目裡，我會跟大家分享回到中國之後的感覺。
transcript.translation: In future episodes, I’ll share my thoughts on what it’s like to be back in China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我相信會有很多讓我吃驚的事情。
transcript.translation: I’m sure there will be plenty of surprises in store for me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 最後說說新的一年想做的事情。2025年我們會繼續做茶歇中文播客，一個月一集或者兩集。
transcript.translation: Finally, let’s talk about what we want to do in the new year. In 2025, we’ll continue the “Tea Break Chinese” podcast, with one or two episodes a month.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們會繼續做茶歇新聞播客，一個星期一集或者兩集。
transcript.translation: We’ll keep producing the “Tea Break News” podcast—one or two episodes a week.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們還會做不少採訪，採訪那些有意思的人，我們會採訪中國人，也會採訪瞭解中國的外國人。
transcript.translation: We’ll also be doing plenty of interviews with interesting people—we’ll interview Chinese people, as well as foreigners who understand China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們會聊文學，也會聊政治。
transcript.translation: We’ll talk about literature, and we’ll talk about politics.
