transcript.text: 你在手機上點菜就像在 Amazon 上買東西，把自己想要的東西放在籃子裡，然後你在手機上付錢。
transcript.translation: Ordering food on your phone is just like shopping on Amazon: you add what you want to your cart, and then you pay on your phone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 付錢的時候，手機告訴你如果你有 TikTok，在 TikTok 上推薦這個飯店，你就會收到 coupons。
transcript.translation: When you pay, your phone tells you that if you have TikTok and recommend this restaurant on TikTok, you’ll receive coupons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 於是你開啟 TikTok 找到這個飯店，推薦這個飯店，然後收到 coupons。
transcript.translation: So you open TikTok, find this restaurant, recommend it, and then receive coupons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 你要付錢的時候，手機又告訴你，如果你買這個飯店的 gift cards 就有折扣，就有 discount。
transcript.translation: Just as you’re about to pay, your phone notifies you that you’ll get a discount if you buy gift cards from this restaurant.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 於是你又去買 gift cards。
transcript.translation: So you end up buying gift cards again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 終於你點好了菜，付好了錢。
transcript.translation: Finally, you’ve ordered your food and paid the bill.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在你可以等服務員上菜。
transcript.translation: Now you can wait for the server to bring your food.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 吃完飯，你起來出飯店。
transcript.translation: After finishing your meal, get up and leave the restaurant.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有的飯店的服務員會跟你說再見，有的飯店什麼也不說。
transcript.translation: At some restaurants, the waitstaff will say goodbye to you; at others, they won’t say a word.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這就是在上海去飯店的感覺。
transcript.translation: That’s what it’s like to go to a restaurant in Shanghai.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我真的覺得很奇怪。
transcript.translation: I really find that strange.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 除了吃飯，坐地鐵，坐公交、買火車票、買公園的門票都是在手機上完成的。
transcript.translation: Aside from eating, taking the subway, riding the bus, buying train tickets, and purchasing park admission tickets—all of these are done on a smartphone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我的中國朋友們肯定都習慣了。
transcript.translation: My Chinese friends are surely used to it by now.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 而我呢？
transcript.translation: And what about me?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我覺得很累。
transcript.translation: I feel really exhausted.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [鐘聲]第二，在中國，我感覺不到歷史。
transcript.translation: [Bell] Second, in China, I don’t feel a sense of history.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在法國旅行的時候，一路上我們總是看見很多老的建築，老的房子，老的城堡，有名的人住過的地方。
transcript.translation: While traveling in France, we kept seeing old buildings, old houses, old castles, and places where famous people once lived.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在法國，我感覺自己在一個很老的國家，一個很有歷史的國家。
transcript.translation: In France, I feel like I’m in a very old country—a country steeped in history.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 尤其是在小城市裡，每一個房子好像都有自己的故事。
transcript.translation: Especially in smaller cities, it seems like every house has its own story.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在巴黎這樣的大城市也是到處都是歷史。
transcript.translation: In a big city like Paris, history is everywhere.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在中國呢？
transcript.translation: What about in China?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 雖然中國的歷史比法國久，但是老的東西，有歷史的東西卻比法國少。
transcript.translation: Although China has a longer history than France, it has fewer old things and fewer items with historical significance.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 到處都是新的房子，新的地鐵站。
transcript.translation: There are new buildings and new subway stations everywhere.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在上海的市中心都是外國的商店，Starbucks 、 McDonald's 、Louis Vuitton 、 Gucci 等等。
transcript.translation: Downtown Shanghai is full of foreign stores—Starbucks, McDonald’s, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, and so on.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 老的房子慢慢地沒有了，新的高樓越來越多。
transcript.translation: Old buildings are slowly disappearing, while new high-rises are popping up everywhere.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 每一個城市好像都是一樣的。
transcript.translation: It seems to be the same in every city.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這一點我真的不喜歡。
transcript.translation: I really don’t like that.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [鐘聲]第三，中國的年輕人讓我擔心。
transcript.translation: [Bell] Third, I’m worried about China’s young people.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 這個話題以後我可能還會再說在今天的節目裡，我就簡單地聊聊。
transcript.translation: I might revisit this topic in the future, but for today’s show, I’ll just touch on it briefly.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我很擔心今天中國的年輕人。
transcript.translation: I’m very concerned about young people in China today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很多年輕人跟我一樣，是家裡唯一的孩子，也就是獨生子女。
transcript.translation: Many young people, like me, are the only child in their family—that is, only children.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們長大的時候，因為沒有兄弟姐妹，所以常常很孤單。
transcript.translation: Growing up, because we didn’t have any brothers or sisters, we often felt lonely.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我看見年輕人都在手機上看 Tiktok 這樣沒有用的東西。
transcript.translation: Nowadays, I see young people spending their time on their phones watching useless stuff like TikTok.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 年輕人都想買 Labubu 這種不好看的東西。
transcript.translation: Young people all want to buy ugly things like Labubu.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: Whenever Chinese retailer Pop Mart drops a new labubu designer toy, it sells out within minutes.
transcript.translation: Whenever Chinese retailer Pop Mart releases a new Labubu designer toy, it sells out within minutes.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 年輕人工作很辛苦，但是房子很貴。
transcript.translation: Young people work very hard, but housing is very expensive.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果父母沒有錢的話，我們很難在上海、北京這樣的大城市裡有自己的房子。
transcript.translation: If our parents don’t have money, it’s very hard for us to own our own homes in big cities like Shanghai and Beijing.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 結婚的年輕人也越來越少。
transcript.translation: Fewer and fewer young people are getting married.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不少男女生活在一起，但是不結婚，也不要孩子。
transcript.translation: Many men and women live together but don’t get married or have children.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我在想，二十年後中國會是什麼樣的？
transcript.translation: I wonder what China will be like twenty years from now?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們這一代年輕人真的能讓中國越來越好嗎？
transcript.translation: Can our generation of young people truly make China better and better?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我有不少擔心。
transcript.translation: I have quite a few concerns.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: [片尾音樂]
transcript.translation: [Closing music]

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我在法國寫這一集播客，我又來歐洲了。
transcript.translation: I’m writing this episode of the podcast from France—I’m back in Europe again.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在法國生活和在中國生活是兩種感覺。
transcript.translation: Living in France and living in China are two completely different experiences.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 兩個國家都有我喜歡的地方，也有我討厭的地方。
transcript.translation: There are things I like and things I dislike about both countries.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是有一點我想告訴大家，那就是我們在新聞裡看見的，聽見的都不是真的。
transcript.translation: But there’s one thing I’d like to tell everyone: what we see and hear in the news isn’t always true.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在法國的新聞裡，每天都是說中國的壞話。
transcript.translation: In the French news, they say bad things about China every day.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在中國的新聞裡，我們感覺中國是世界上最好的國家。
transcript.translation: From the news in China, we get the impression that China is the best country in the world.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們不能從新聞裡瞭解一個國家。
transcript.translation: We can’t understand a country just from the news.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在中國的兩個月裡，我跟家人朋友聊天，也去了一些地方旅行。
transcript.translation: During my two months in China, I chatted with family and friends and traveled to a few places.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我對今天的中國有了新的瞭解。
transcript.translation: I’ve gained a new understanding of China today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這一集節目裡，我把在中國的所見所聞告訴了大家。
transcript.translation: In this episode, I shared with you what I saw and heard during my time in China.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 當然還有很多可以說的，我還有很多想跟大家分享的東西，可能我會在以後的節目裡慢慢跟你分享，可能我會寫下來或者做影片，
transcript.translation: Of course, there’s still a lot to talk about, and I have many things I’d like to share with you all. I might gradually share them with you in future episodes, or perhaps I’ll write them down or make a video,

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 然後放在茶歇中文的網站上。
transcript.translation: Then post it on the TeaTime Chinese website.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果你現在去查些中文的網站上的話，你會看見現在的網站和以前不一樣了。
transcript.translation: If you visit some Chinese websites now, you’ll see that they’re different from what they used to be.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 以後我想在網站上放越來越多有趣的文章、影片、播客，歡迎你常常去網站上看看。
transcript.translation: In the future, I plan to post more and more interesting articles, videos, and podcasts on the website. Feel free to visit the site often.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文還在繼續。
transcript.translation: TeaTime Chinese continues.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 那麼這一集的節目就到這裡，感謝你的收聽。
transcript.translation: That wraps up this episode. Thank you for listening.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們下一期節目再見。
transcript.translation: See you in our next episode.

transcript.speaker: speaker_4
transcript.text: [片尾音樂] You're listening to a TeaTime Chinese production.
transcript.translation: [Closing Music] You're listening to a TeaTime Chinese production.

transcript.speaker: speaker_4
transcript.text: We want to make the Chinese language comprehensible for everyone.
transcript.translation: We want to make the Chinese language accessible to everyone.

transcript.speaker: speaker_4
transcript.text: Please share with your friends, classmates or leave a review wherever you listen to the podcast.
transcript.translation: Please share with your friends and classmates, or leave a review wherever you listen to the podcast.

transcript.speaker: speaker_4
transcript.text: Thank you for your attention.
transcript.translation: Thank you for listening.

transcript.speaker: speaker_4
transcript.text: [片尾音樂]
transcript.translation: [Closing music]

meaning.en: What someone has personally seen and heard; their firsthand observations and experiences. This formal four-character expression is common in titles and written accounts.
meaning.vi: Những điều một người đã tận mắt thấy và tận tai nghe; các quan sát và trải nghiệm trực tiếp của họ. Cụm bốn chữ trang trọng này thường xuất hiện trong tiêu đề và bài viết.

vocabulary.example: 茶歇中文第96集，在中國的所見所聞。

meaning.en: Perfectly ordinary or completely unremarkable. This colloquial AABB reduplication gives more emphasis than 普通.
meaning.vi: Hết sức bình thường, hoàn toàn không có gì đặc biệt. Dạng lặp AABB khẩu ngữ này nhấn mạnh hơn 普通.

vocabulary.example: 比如說在法國，如果你去飯店吃飯一頓普普通通的飯最少也要十歐元。

meaning.en: An only child, especially in the context of Chinese family structure and the former one-child policy. It is a common social and demographic term.
meaning.vi: Con một, đặc biệt trong bối cảnh cấu trúc gia đình Trung Quốc và chính sách một con trước đây. Đây là thuật ngữ xã hội và nhân khẩu học thông dụng.

vocabulary.example: 很多年輕人跟我一樣，是家裡唯一的孩子，也就是獨生子女。

title: TeaTime Chinese 茶歇中文
author: TeaTime Chinese
episode: 第97集 : 《奧德賽》和茶歇中文的回來 The Odyssey and the Comeback of TeaTime Chinese

levelReason.en: Transcript-only rating: about 124 characters per minute, 2 voices, and median recoverable pauses of 1.3 seconds.
levelReason.vi: Xếp mức dễ hơn dựa trên bản chép lời: khoảng 124 chữ/phút và 2 giọng nói.

learningGoal.en: Follow a full 28-minute Mandarin episode by ear, without leaning on the translation.
learningGoal.vi: Nghe hiểu trọn một tập podcast tiếng Quan thoại dài 28 phút mà không dựa vào bản dịch.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文第九十七集，奧德賽和茶歇中文的回來。
transcript.translation: Tea Break Chinese Episode 97: The Odyssey and Tea Break Chinese are back.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [舒緩的片頭音樂]
transcript.translation:
[Soothing opening music]
Hello, listeners of "Tea Break in Chinese." I’m Nathan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文的聽眾朋友們你們好，我是Nathan。
transcript.translation:
[Soothing opening music]
Hello, listeners of "Tea Break in Chinese." I’m Nathan.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 歡迎你收聽我們的節目。
transcript.translation: Thank you for listening to our show.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在這裡我們用簡單的中文聊有意思的話題。
transcript.translation: Here, we chat about interesting topics in simple Chinese.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 幾個星期前我去電影院裡看了《奧德賽》這部電影。
transcript.translation: A few weeks ago, I went to the movie theater to see the film *The Odyssey*.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在很多人都在聊這部電影。
transcript.translation: A lot of people are talking about this movie right now.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 有的人很喜歡，有的人很不喜歡。
transcript.translation: Some people love it, while others really dislike it.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 每個人都有自己的理由。
transcript.translation: Everyone has their own reasons.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 看了電影，我不由得想到我自己的生活，想到茶歇中文。“不由得”是什麼意思？
transcript.translation: After watching the movie, I couldn’t help but think about my own life and the Chinese I learned during the tea break. What does “couldn’t help but” mean?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 不由得做一件事情，意思就是很自然地去做這件事情。
transcript.translation: "Can’t help but do something" means to do it quite naturally.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 英文裡可以翻譯成 cannot help but do something。
transcript.translation: In English, this can be translated as “cannot help but do something.”

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 看完電影，我不由得想到自己的生活，我很自然地想到自己的生活。
transcript.translation: After watching the movie, I couldn’t help but think about my own life—it just came to mind naturally.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 是的，從2025年開始，我們就沒有再做新的節目，到現在已經一年半了。
transcript.translation: Yes, we haven’t produced any new episodes since 2025, and it’s been a year and a half now.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我感覺自己就像是電影裡的Odysseus，經歷了很多事情，而沒能繼續做茶歇中文一直是讓我覺得很遺憾的事情。
transcript.translation: I feel just like Odysseus in the movie—I’ve been through so much, and not being able to continue “Tea Break Chinese” has always been a source of regret for me.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我常常心裡想，等我有空了一定要寫一集節目。
transcript.translation: I often think to myself that when I have some free time, I’ll definitely write an episode of the show.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是生活裡一直有各種各樣的事情，一年半就這樣過去了。
transcript.translation: But life is full of all sorts of things, and a year and a half just flew by.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 但是我知道做茶歇中文是我最喜歡做得事情。
transcript.translation: But I know that preparing tea breaks is my favorite thing to do.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 茶歇中文是最讓我開心的事情，因為我喜歡寫文章，喜歡做播客。
transcript.translation: "Tea Break in Chinese" is what makes me happiest, because I love writing articles and making podcasts.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 現在我希望茶歇中文能像 Odysseus 一樣回來。
transcript.translation: Now I hope “Tea Break Chinese” can return just like Odysseus did.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在今天的這一集播客裡，我們就一起來看看奧德賽的故事。
transcript.translation: In today’s podcast episode, let’s take a look at the story of the Odyssey.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 聽了今天的節目，可能你會對電影有新的看法。
transcript.translation: After listening to today’s episode, you might gain a new perspective on the movie.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 如果你沒有讀過奧德賽，也沒有看過電影的話，我也希望你會喜歡今天的節目。
transcript.translation: Even if you haven’t read *The Odyssey* or seen the movie, I hope you’ll enjoy today’s episode.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在講故事之前，我們先簡單地來看看奧德賽是誰寫的，是什麼時候寫的。
transcript.translation: Before we begin the story, let’s briefly look at who wrote *The Odyssey* and when it was written.

transcript.speaker: speaker_1
transcript.text: [ transition音效 ]
transcript.translation: [ transition sound effect ]

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 奧德賽和伊利亞特是西方最早的文學。
transcript.translation: The Odyssey and the Iliad are the earliest works of Western literature.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 兩個故事的作者都是荷馬Homer。
transcript.translation: Both stories were written by Homer.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 今天關於荷馬我們知道的不多。
transcript.translation: We don’t know much about Homer today.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們知道什麼？
transcript.translation: What do we know?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他是一個詩人，一個poet。
transcript.translation: He is a poet.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他出生在三千多年前的希臘。
transcript.translation: He was born in Greece more than 3,000 years ago.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 希臘就是Greece。
transcript.translation: Greece is Greece.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 他是一個盲人，意思是說他的眼睛是壞的，他看不見東西。
transcript.translation: He is blind, which means his eyes are bad and he cannot see.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 荷馬是一個詩人，奧德賽是他做的詩。
transcript.translation: Homer was a poet, and *The Odyssey* is a poem he wrote.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們不能說荷馬寫了奧德塞，因為他沒有把它寫下來，而是從嘴裡說出了這首詩。
transcript.translation: We can’t say that Homer wrote the *Odyssey*, because he didn’t write it down—he recited the poem orally.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 很有意思的是，中國最早的文學也是詩，名字叫《詩經》。《詩經》和奧德賽出現的時間是差不多的。
transcript.translation: Interestingly, China’s earliest literature was also poetry, titled *The Book of Songs*. *The Book of Songs* and *The Odyssey* appeared around the same time.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 可能我會做一集節目給大家介紹一下《詩經》。
transcript.translation: I might do an episode to introduce everyone to the *Book of Songs*.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 我們回到奧德賽。《奧德賽》這首詩講了什麼故事呢？
transcript.translation: Let’s go back to *The Odyssey*. What story does the poem *The Odyssey* tell?

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 故事的主角，故事裡最重要的人叫奧德修斯。
transcript.translation: The main character—the most important person in the story—is Odysseus.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在電影裡，他的名字是 Odysseus。
transcript.translation: In the movie, his name is Odysseus.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在英文裡和別的語言裡，他的名字也可以是 Ulysses。
transcript.translation: In English and other languages, his name is also sometimes spelled Ulysses.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 在希臘語裡，它的名字是 Οδυσσέας。
transcript.translation: In Greek, his name is Οδυσσέας.

transcript.speaker: speaker_0
transcript.text: 後來翻譯成拉丁語的時候，拉丁語的翻譯是 Ulixes。
transcript.translation: Later, when it was translated into Latin, the Latin name became Ulysses.

meaning.en: Involuntarily or unable to help doing something; it introduces a natural, spontaneous reaction. It is somewhat more literary than 忍不住.
meaning.vi: Bất giác, không kìm được mà làm gì đó; dùng để dẫn vào một phản ứng tự nhiên, tự phát. Mang sắc thái văn chương hơn 忍不住 một chút.

vocabulary.example: 看了電影，我不由得想到我自己的生活，想到茶歇中文。“不由得”是什麼意思？

meaning.en: To make a long story short; used to move quickly to the main point or summarize a complicated account. It is a common four-character conversational expression.
meaning.vi: Nói ngắn gọn lại; dùng để đi nhanh vào ý chính hoặc tóm tắt một câu chuyện phức tạp. Đây là cụm bốn chữ rất thông dụng trong hội thoại.

vocabulary.example: 我們長話短說，現在來聽故事。你準備好了嗎？

meaning.en: To string a bow by attaching and tightening its bowstring. It is a specialized verb-object expression; in other contexts, 上弦 can also mean winding a mechanical device.
meaning.vi: Lắp và căng dây cung. Đây là kết cấu động-tân chuyên biệt; trong ngữ cảnh khác, 上弦 còn có nghĩa lên dây cót một thiết bị cơ khí.

meaning.en: Tattered, ragged, or badly worn and damaged. This vivid, colloquial AABB adjective is more emphatic than 破爛.

meaning.en: Emotional blackmail: the use of guilt, fear, obligation, or affection to pressure someone into complying. This is a common term in relationship and popular-psychology discussions.
meaning.vi: Tống tiền cảm xúc: dùng cảm giác tội lỗi, sợ hãi, nghĩa vụ hay tình cảm để gây sức ép buộc người khác làm theo ý mình. Đây là thuật ngữ thông dụng khi bàn về quan hệ và tâm lý học đại chúng.

vocabulary.example: 那我們之間相處得還不錯，那坊間呢兩性專家常提到的反面教材，像是受委屈啊，情緒勒索啊，爭吵啊，磨合不順等等等等，這些呀在我們身上幾乎都沒有發生。

meaning.en: Taiwanese shorthand for labor insurance and National Health Insurance, especially when discussing basic employee benefits. It is Taiwan-specific institutional vocabulary.
meaning.vi: Cách nói tắt ở Đài Loan cho bảo hiểm lao động và bảo hiểm y tế toàn dân, nhất là khi bàn về phúc lợi cơ bản của người lao động. Đây là từ vựng thể chế riêng của Đài Loan.

vocabulary.example: 此外啊，工程行款項入帳的時間不固定，薪水由父母發放，不僅啊發薪不準時，還常常被剋扣，甚至連基本的勞健保都沒有。

meaning.en: Deep, lingering resentment or bitterness toward someone after grievances have accumulated. The word has a formal or literary tone.
meaning.vi: Nỗi oán hận sâu sắc, dai dẳng đối với ai đó sau khi những bất bình đã tích tụ. Từ này mang sắc thái trang trọng hoặc văn chương.

vocabulary.example: 他卻沒辦法陪我實踐，沒辦法攜手前進，我覺得我心裡會有怨懟，也會有遺憾。

meaning.en: To cut one’s losses and stop further damage. Originally financial jargon for executing a stop-loss, it is widely extended in Taiwanese Mandarin to careers and relationships.
meaning.vi: Cắt lỗ và ngăn thiệt hại lan rộng thêm. Vốn là thuật ngữ tài chính chỉ lệnh dừng lỗ, từ này được mở rộng rộng rãi trong tiếng Hoa Đài Loan sang chuyện sự nghiệp và tình cảm.

vocabulary.example: 那方案B呢，是停損跟重尋。我是不是應該果斷放棄這段舒適的關係，重新出發去尋找另外一個可以讓我產生靈魂共鳴又有能力陪我一起實踐這個夢想的人。

meaning.en: A proverb meaning that poverty makes every aspect of married life difficult or sorrowful. It is commonly quoted when discussing the strain that financial hardship places on a relationship.
meaning.vi: Một câu tục ngữ nói rằng nghèo khó khiến mọi mặt của đời sống vợ chồng đều trở nên khốn khó hay buồn tủi. Thường được dẫn ra khi bàn về áp lực mà khó khăn tài chính đặt lên một mối quan hệ.

vocabulary.example: 那我覺得這個我可以理解，畢竟貧賤夫妻百事哀，財務的安全感確實是很多人生活穩定的這個基礎啊基石。

meaning.en: To avoid someone or something at all costs, as though afraid one cannot get away fast enough. It is emphatic and somewhat formal.
meaning.vi: Tránh xa ai đó hay điều gì đó bằng mọi giá, như thể sợ mình chạy không kịp. Cách nói này nhấn mạnh và hơi trang trọng.

vocabulary.example: 這些潛規則呢，很多上班族啊覺得是黑暗的職場政治，避之唯恐不及。

meaning.en: To unravel a complicated matter layer by layer in order to reveal its underlying logic or truth. This vivid idiom is often used for analysis, investigations, and explanations.
meaning.vi: Gỡ dần từng lớp một vấn đề phức tạp để làm lộ ra logic hay sự thật bên dưới. Thành ngữ sinh động này thường dùng cho phân tích, điều tra và giải thích.

vocabulary.example: 但是啊，我們會帶大家抽絲剝繭，瞭解其中的邏輯，並且呢教大家如何回應。

meaning.en: Makeshift, homemade, or improvised with simple local methods rather than professional resources. This is informal Taiwanese slang and can imply roughness but also ingenuity.
meaning.vi: Tạm bợ, tự chế, làm bằng phương pháp thô sơ tại chỗ thay vì bằng nguồn lực chuyên nghiệp. Đây là tiếng lóng thân mật của Đài Loan, có thể hàm ý thô sơ nhưng cũng hàm ý khéo xoay xở.

vocabulary.example: 好就土炮，就弄成一個他心中好用的箱子。

meaning.en: Literally, “cut one’s feet to fit the shoes”; figuratively, to distort oneself or reality in order to conform to rigid requirements. It is a literary idiom often used critically.
meaning.vi: Nghĩa đen là “gọt chân cho vừa giày”; nghĩa bóng là bóp méo bản thân hay thực tế để chiều theo những đòi hỏi cứng nhắc. Đây là thành ngữ văn chương, thường dùng với ý phê phán.

vocabulary.example: 然後我們這些人呢，就想辦法叫削足適履啊，我們把自己削成這個標準的職涯、職業、職位該有的樣子，而不去問你自己的天賦跟熱情。

meaning.en: To have absolutely no connection with someone or something. This is a highly colloquial expression, often followed by 跟……有關係 or simply used with 跟.
meaning.vi: Hoàn toàn chẳng liên quan gì đến ai đó hay điều gì đó. Đây là cách nói rất khẩu ngữ, thường đi kèm 跟……有關係 hoặc đơn giản dùng với 跟.

vocabulary.example: 所以跟這個遊戲啊八竿子打不著關係，他是修機器的。

meaning.en: A “pain point”: a recurring problem, frustration, or unmet need experienced by customers, users, or employees. It is common jargon in business and product development.
meaning.vi: “Điểm đau”: một vấn đề, nỗi bực bội hay nhu cầu chưa được đáp ứng lặp đi lặp lại mà khách hàng, người dùng hay nhân viên gặp phải. Đây là thuật ngữ thông dụng trong kinh doanh và phát triển sản phẩm.

vocabulary.example: 因為你解決的問題是公司大家的痛點，我相信一定有資源的人願意資-直屬你，而且你又沒有要求我要加薪，對不對？

meaning.en: Basic, bare-bones, or lacking polished features and extras. This informal sense of 陽春 is especially common in Taiwanese Mandarin.
meaning.vi: Đơn giản, trần trụi, thiếu các tính năng hay phụ kiện cao cấp. Nghĩa thân mật này của 陽春 đặc biệt phổ biến trong tiếng Hoa Đài Loan.

vocabulary.example: 第一個觀察身邊有哪些問題沒有被解決；第二個創作，好，試著用quick and dirty 陽春的方式看能不能解決這個問題；再來做出成品之後無償分享給大家，看看，不是我們要耍大方，而是要看看大家用的結果如何。

transcript.translation: In our work and personal lives, we inevitably encounter negative emotions, big and small—perhaps fear of the future, a sense of helplessness in the face of setbacks, or various feelings of loss, stress, a lack of fairness, or anxiety.

transcript.text: 能把生活過得好的人，往往也擅長排解自己的情緒。

transcript.translation: Otherwise, before reality even has a chance to knock us down, we’ll already be tied up by our own emotions—unable to take a single step, let alone pursue our passions in life.

meaning.en: To drain oneself mentally through overthinking, anxiety, self-criticism, or unresolved internal conflict. This is a contemporary buzzword in psychology, workplace, and social-media discussions.
meaning.vi: Tự bào mòn tinh thần vì suy nghĩ quá nhiều, lo âu, tự trách hay mâu thuẫn nội tâm chưa được giải quyết. Đây là từ thời thượng trong các cuộc thảo luận về tâm lý, công sở và mạng xã hội.

meaning.en: Emotionally fragile or easily hurt by criticism. Literally “glass-hearted,” this is informal internet slang and can be teasing or dismissive.

meaning.en: A structured simulation or rehearsal of possible scenarios and responses. Originally associated with military planning, it is now common in business and figurative use.
meaning.vi: Một buổi mô phỏng hay diễn tập có cấu trúc về các kịch bản và cách ứng phó có thể xảy ra. Vốn gắn với công tác hoạch định quân sự, nay đã phổ biến trong kinh doanh và trong cách dùng ẩn dụ.

meaning.en: A “digital product passport”: a digital record of a product’s materials, origin, repairability, and recycling information, often accessed through a QR code. This is specialized sustainability and EU regulatory terminology.
meaning.vi: “Hộ chiếu sản phẩm số”: một hồ sơ số ghi lại vật liệu, xuất xứ, khả năng sửa chữa và thông tin tái chế của sản phẩm, thường truy cập qua mã QR. Đây là thuật ngữ chuyên ngành về phát triển bền vững và quy định của EU.

vocabulary.example: 因為歐盟最近就有在推數位產品護照啊。

meaning.en: A traceability record documenting an agricultural product’s production and distribution history. This official term is especially common in Taiwan.
meaning.vi: Hồ sơ truy xuất nguồn gốc ghi lại lịch sử sản xuất và phân phối của một nông sản. Thuật ngữ chính thức này đặc biệt phổ biến ở Đài Loan.

vocabulary.example: 所以這個就跟那個農產品的產銷履歷一樣很像嘛。

meaning.en: A little-known company or industry that is nevertheless a world leader in a specialized market—a “hidden champion.” The term is used in business and economics.
meaning.vi: Một doanh nghiệp hay ngành ít người biết đến nhưng lại dẫn đầu thế giới trong một thị trường ngách — “nhà vô địch ẩn danh”. Thuật ngữ này dùng trong kinh doanh và kinh tế học.

vocabulary.example: 那我跟大家說這件事情跟臺灣很有關係啊，因為我們是做這個機能布跟這個棉紡外交的隱形冠軍，我們是隱形冠軍哦。

meaning.en: Genuine, authentic, or truly representative of a place or type. This is an informal Taiwan expression influenced by Taiwanese Hokkien.
meaning.vi: Chính hiệu, thật sự, đúng chất của một nơi chốn hay một loại nào đó. Đây là cách nói thân mật của Đài Loan, chịu ảnh hưởng của tiếng Mân Nam Đài Loan.

vocabulary.example: 正港的臺南人啊。你的學長。我的學長啊，也是你的學長啊，江浩佑。

meaning.en: The Group Representation Constituency system, in which a party fields a team of candidates and the entire team wins or loses together. This is specialized electoral terminology used especially in discussions of Singapore.
meaning.vi: Chế độ đơn vị bầu cử theo nhóm, trong đó một đảng đưa ra một đội ứng viên và cả đội cùng thắng hoặc cùng thua. Đây là thuật ngữ bầu cử chuyên biệt, đặc biệt dùng khi bàn về Singapore.

vocabulary.example: 這聊，就聊到新加坡的選舉哦，他說這我人生第一次聽到集選區制這個，這個概念。

meaning.en: Discretion: the legally permitted authority of a judge or official to choose among possible decisions. This is a formal legal and administrative term.
meaning.vi: Quyền tự quyết: thẩm quyền được pháp luật cho phép để một thẩm phán hay quan chức lựa chọn giữa các phương án quyết định. Đây là thuật ngữ pháp lý và hành chính trang trọng.

vocabulary.example: 反正呢最後的研究就是會發現，就是呃，因為鞭刑是由法官的裁量去施加的，所以在比較受鞭者跟未受鞭者，然後比較的狀況底下，會發現其實是比較沒有辦法去證明鞭刑是有格外的嚇阻力的。

meaning.en: “Troubled times call for harsh punishments”: a saying used to argue that severe disorder should be met with severe laws or penalties. It commonly appears in political and criminal-justice debate.
meaning.vi: “Thời loạn phải dùng hình phạt nặng”: một câu nói dùng để lập luận rằng tình trạng hỗn loạn nghiêm trọng phải được đáp lại bằng luật lệ hay hình phạt nghiêm khắc. Thường xuất hiện trong tranh luận chính trị và tư pháp hình sự.

vocabulary.example: 所以就變成是，對專家來說會覺得說我們一直是覺得說要重刑化、亂世用重典，先不管是不是亂世——

meaning.en: Breach of trust: the offense of harming another person’s interests while entrusted with managing their affairs. This is primarily a formal legal term.
meaning.vi: Bội tín: hành vi phạm tội gây tổn hại lợi ích của người khác trong khi được giao quản lý công việc của họ. Đây chủ yếu là thuật ngữ pháp lý trang trọng.

vocabulary.example: 是啊，陳青青不是違反特別背信罪起-- 被起訴嗎？

meaning.en: A negligent offense: a crime caused by carelessness rather than deliberate intent. This is formal criminal-law terminology.
meaning.vi: Tội phạm do vô ý: hành vi phạm tội gây ra bởi sự bất cẩn chứ không phải cố ý. Đây là thuật ngữ luật hình sự trang trọng.

vocabulary.example: 你就不要過失犯罪。對啊。你就不要不小心推到別人，別人跌到。

meaning.en: To do the bare minimum simply so that one can report a task as completed, without caring about its quality or substance. It has a critical, often conversational tone.
meaning.vi: Làm cho có, chỉ đủ để báo cáo là đã xong việc, không quan tâm đến chất lượng hay nội dung thực chất. Cụm từ mang sắc thái phê phán, thường dùng trong hội thoại.

vocabulary.example: 他其實可能就是要交差了事。哦，也有可能。

transcript.translation: But when we hit middle and high school—a time of intense political polarization—it’s easy to start associating politics with terror, conflict, and fear, and we might feel paralyzed and want to run away.

transcript.translation: So for a while—a very long time—he chose a rather extreme but self-preserving approach: he temporarily disconnected from reality, withdrew from his social circle, and retreated into nature to give himself space to breathe and settle his emotions first.

meaning.en: To donate or tip money to an online creator, streamer, or program. This is informal internet slang, especially common in Taiwan, derived from English “donate.”

meaning.en: An online insult for someone considered poorly educated or ignorant, derived from 九年義務教育漏網之魚, “someone who slipped through the net of nine-year compulsory education.” It is mocking and derogatory, so it should be used cautiously.

meaning.en: A particular year viewed in terms of the fortune and events it may bring, especially in astrology or Chinese fortune-telling. 看流年 means to examine someone’s prospects for a given year.

meaning.en: To have an off-the-charts sense of responsibility. 爆表 literally means that a gauge has exceeded its maximum and is colloquial and emphatic.
meaning.vi: Có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao vượt mọi thang đo. 爆表 nghĩa đen là kim đồng hồ đo đã vượt quá vạch tối đa, và là cách nói khẩu ngữ, nhấn mạnh.

vocabulary.example: 我的問題是如何讓這幾位責任感爆表、自我要求高的主管們可以放下焦慮進行有效溝通？

meaning.en: To leave someone in an official position while stripping them of real authority, making the role merely nominal. It is commonly used in organizational and political contexts.
meaning.vi: Để ai đó ngồi nguyên ở một chức vụ nhưng tước hết quyền lực thực chất, khiến vai trò đó chỉ còn trên danh nghĩa. Thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh tổ chức và chính trị.

meaning.en: To pretend to obey openly while secretly acting in opposition. This idiom is strongly critical and often describes insincere compliance with orders or policy.
